ipa.title: 辅音
ipa.subtitle: 按 15 个构音部位与 13 种构音方式排列；口腔构音 12 列与喉部构音 3 列分区。含扩展字母及无连音线塞擦音与喷音组合；空格不表示构音不可能。

ipa.title: 元音
ipa.subtitle: 同一位置的左项不圆唇，右项圆唇。图形展示舌位关系，不是实测声道剖面。

ipa.title: 其他符号与连音线
ipa.subtitle: 独立挤喉记号与连音线。

groups.label: 喷音记号
groups.hint: 喉部闭合并上升，压缩口腔内气体，形成外向喉气流。

groups.label: 上连音线
groups.hint: 用于把两个符号关联为塞擦音或双重构音等一个构音单位。

groups.label: 下连音线
groups.hint: 用于把两个符号关联为塞擦音或双重构音等一个构音单位。

ipa.title: 附加符号
ipa.subtitle: 每组先给独立附加记号，再给原表可点击示例；虚线圆仅作定位。

groups.label: 清化
groups.hint: 原本常为浊音的音段不伴或减少声带周期振动。

groups.label: 浊化
groups.hint: 给通常为清音的音段标记声带振动。

groups.label: 送气
groups.hint: 辅音释放后具有可辨的气流噪声或较长声门开放期。

groups.label: 更圆
groups.hint: 相对基底音的典型唇形，增加圆唇程度。

groups.label: 略展
groups.hint: 相对基底音减少圆唇程度。

groups.label: 偏前
groups.hint: 主要舌部构音位置相对基底音向前。

groups.label: 偏后
groups.hint: 主要舌部构音位置相对基底音向后。

groups.label: 央化
groups.hint: 元音舌位从前或后的位置向央部靠拢。

groups.label: 中-央化
groups.hint: 元音向元音空间的中央区域靠拢，同时涉及高低和前后维度。

groups.label: 成音节
groups.hint: 使所标音段承担音节核功能。

groups.label: 不成音节
groups.hint: 使所标元音或响音不独立承担音节核功能。

groups.label: r音色
groups.hint: 为元音标记 r 类音色，不指定唯一舌形。

groups.label: 气声性
groups.hint: 声带振动伴随较明显的漏气声。

groups.label: 嘎裂声性
groups.hint: 标记较低频或不规则声带振动的嘎裂特征，不等于一般粗糙音质。

groups.label: 舌唇
groups.hint: 舌尖或舌叶与上唇接触或接近。

groups.label: 唇化
groups.hint: 主构音伴随附加圆唇或唇部收拢。

groups.label: 腭化
groups.hint: 主构音伴随舌面朝硬腭抬起。

groups.label: 软腭化
groups.hint: 主构音伴随舌后部向软腭接近。

groups.label: 咽化
groups.hint: 主构音伴随咽部收缩，具体机制应按语音材料说明。

groups.label: 软腭化或咽化
groups.hint: 横贯字母的附加记号，概括软腭化或咽化；需要明确机制时用专门记号。

groups.label: 偏高
groups.hint: 使元音舌位更高，或使辅音狭窄程度增大。

groups.label: 偏低
groups.hint: 使元音舌位更低，或使辅音狭窄程度减小。

groups.label: 舌根偏前
groups.hint: 描述舌根向前的构音设置；不等同于整个舌体的前移。

groups.label: 舌根偏后
groups.hint: 描述舌根向后收缩的设置；不等同于笼统的后元音。

groups.label: 齿化
groups.hint: 构音接触向牙齿区域调整。

groups.label: 舌尖性
groups.hint: 明确活动构音部位为舌尖。

groups.label: 舌叶性
groups.hint: 明确活动构音部位为舌叶，区别于舌尖构音。

groups.label: 鼻化
groups.hint: 口腔气流同时经鼻腔逸出，通常由软腭下降引起。

groups.label: 鼻除阻
groups.hint: 塞音的口腔闭塞经鼻腔开放而释放。

groups.label: 边除阻
groups.hint: 塞音释放时气流沿舌侧通过。

groups.label: 无闻除阻
groups.hint: 闭塞结束时未听到独立释放爆破，不能由此断言闭塞从未解除。

groups.label: 清化（上置异体）
groups.hint: 有下伸笔画的基底音可把清化小圆放在上方，避免与字母笔画重叠。

groups.label: 主重音
groups.hint: 放在承载主重音的音节前。

groups.label: 次重音
groups.hint: 放在承载次重音的音节前。

groups.label: 长
groups.hint: 放在音段后，标记相对较长时长。

groups.label: 半长
groups.hint: 放在音段后，标记介于短音与长音之间的时长。

groups.label: 超短
groups.hint: 放在基底上方，标记相对很短的时长。

groups.label: 小(音步)组块
groups.hint: 划分较小韵律单位的边界，不自动等于静音。

groups.label: 大(语调)组块
groups.hint: 划分较大语调单位的边界，不规定统一停顿时长。

groups.label: 音节间隔
groups.hint: 标明相邻音节的边界。

groups.label: 连接(间隔不出现)
groups.hint: 表示相邻材料连读且没有明显断开。

ipa.title: 声调与词重调
ipa.subtitle: 调值用相对等级表示；调符与组合音调记号分别可点。

groups.label: 超高调（调符）
groups.hint: 表示超高调。

groups.label: 超高调（附加记号）
groups.hint: 表示超高调。

groups.label: 高调（调符）
groups.hint: 表示高调。

groups.label: 高调（附加记号）
groups.hint: 表示高调。

groups.label: 中调（调符）
groups.hint: 表示中调。

groups.label: 中调（附加记号）
groups.hint: 表示中调。

groups.label: 低调（调符）
groups.hint: 表示低调。

groups.label: 低调（附加记号）
groups.hint: 表示低调。

groups.label: 超低调（调符）
groups.hint: 表示超低调。

groups.label: 超低调（附加记号）
groups.hint: 表示超低调。

groups.label: 升调（调符）
groups.hint: 表示升调。

groups.label: 升调（附加记号）
groups.hint: 表示升调。

groups.label: 降调（调符）
groups.hint: 表示降调。

groups.label: 降调（附加记号）
groups.hint: 表示降调。

groups.label: 高升调（调符）
groups.hint: 表示高升调。

groups.label: 高升调（附加记号）
groups.hint: 表示高升调。

groups.label: 低升调（调符）
groups.hint: 表示低升调。

groups.label: 低升调（附加记号）
groups.hint: 表示低升调。

groups.label: 升降调（调符）
groups.hint: 表示升降调。

groups.label: 升降调（附加记号）
groups.hint: 表示升降调。

groups.label: 降阶
groups.hint: 相对于预期调域降低后续音调，须结合调系解释。

groups.label: 升阶
groups.hint: 相对于预期调域升高后续音调，须结合调系解释。

groups.label: 整体上升
groups.hint: 表示较大语调范围的整体上升趋势。

groups.label: 整体下降
groups.hint: 表示较大语调范围的整体下降趋势。

extipa.title: 额外辅音
extipa.subtitle: 2025 表中未列于 IPA 主表的辅音；每个清浊成员分别可输入。

extipa.title: 附加符号
extipa.subtitle: 定位、气流和构音程度；先点独立记号，或直接使用标为示例的完整组合。

groups.label: 唇展
groups.hint: 双唇横向展开，用于区别同一基底下的唇形变化。

groups.label: 强构音
groups.hint: 相对同类音的参照形式，构音作用较强。

groups.label: 弱构音
groups.hint: 相对同类音的参照形式，构音作用较弱，不直接等于较小音量。

groups.label: 部分去鼻化
groups.hint: 鼻音的鼻腔共鸣或鼻气流相对典型形式减弱，保留“部分”的含义。

groups.label: 摩擦性鼻漏气
groups.hint: 伴随可闻摩擦的鼻部气流逃逸。

groups.label: 腭咽摩擦
groups.hint: 在腭咽区域形成的摩擦伴随基底音。

groups.label: 主要构音偏右
groups.hint: 主要构音位置相对正中向说话人右侧偏移。

groups.label: 主要构音偏左
groups.hint: 主要构音位置相对正中向说话人左侧偏移。

groups.label: 吹哨式构音
groups.hint: 狭窄气流形成明显哨音性质，区别于一般擦音摩擦。

groups.label: 重复构音
groups.hint: 标记同一闭塞或构音动作连续重复，置于反复出现的符号之间。

groups.label: 吸气气流
groups.hint: 放在音段旁标记气流朝内。

groups.label: 滑动构音
groups.hint: 从一个构音位置或音值连续滑向另一位置，箭头连在两基底之间。

extipa.title: 发声与送气
extipa.subtitle: 部分、起始部分和末尾部分分别保留；上置括号用于带下伸部件的基底。

groups.label: 预浊化
groups.hint: 在目标音段之前出现声带振动。

groups.label: 后浊化
groups.hint: 在目标音段之后出现声带振动。

groups.label: 后嘎裂
groups.hint: 在音段之后出现嘎裂声。

groups.label: 部分清化
groups.hint: 部分清化：声带不振动涉及音段的部分时段，括号明确受影响的范围。

groups.label: 部分清化（上置）
groups.hint: 部分清化：声带不振动涉及音段的部分时段，括号明确受影响的范围。

groups.label: 部分浊化
groups.hint: 部分浊化：声带振动只出现在目标音段的一部分。

groups.label: 起始部分清化
groups.hint: 起始部分清化：声带不振动涉及音段的部分时段，括号明确受影响的范围。

groups.label: 起始部分清化（上置）
groups.hint: 起始部分清化：声带不振动涉及音段的部分时段，括号明确受影响的范围。

groups.label: 起始部分浊化
groups.hint: 起始部分浊化：声带振动只出现在目标音段的一部分。

groups.label: 末尾部分清化
groups.hint: 末尾部分清化：声带不振动涉及音段的部分时段，括号明确受影响的范围。

groups.label: 末尾部分清化（上置）
groups.hint: 末尾部分清化：声带不振动涉及音段的部分时段，括号明确受影响的范围。

groups.label: 末尾部分浊化
groups.hint: 末尾部分浊化：声带振动只出现在目标音段的一部分。

groups.label: 预送气
groups.hint: 气流噪声发生在目标辅音之前。

groups.label: 无送气
groups.hint: 明确标记辅音释放没有可辨的附加送气。

groups.label: 长送气（双 h）
groups.hint: 送气持续较长，原表给出重复上标 h 的写法。

groups.label: 长送气（时长）
groups.hint: 送气持续较长，原表也给出上标 h 加上标长音号的写法。

extipa.title: 不确定性、无声构音与外来噪声
extipa.subtitle: 圈围表不确定识别；括号无声构音与双括号外来噪声分开。

groups.label: 不能确定的声音
groups.hint: 已观察到声音，但无法可靠判定其语音性质。

groups.label: 不确定辅音
groups.hint: 只能把声音可靠归入辅音这一类别，不能确定更细的音值。

groups.label: 不确定阻碍音
groups.hint: 只能把声音可靠归入阻碍音这一类别，不能确定更细的音值。

groups.label: 不确定擦音

groups.label: 不确定流音
groups.hint: 只能把声音可靠归入流音这一类别，不能确定更细的音值。

groups.label: 不确定滑音

groups.label: 舌尖 r
groups.hint: 以舌尖为主要构音器官的 r 类近音。

groups.label: 团舌 r
groups.hint: 舌体团起形成的 r 类音色，不能单凭 r 音色推断舌尖卷起。

groups.label: 舌叶清咝音
groups.hint: 舌叶构成主要狭窄，可包括舌尖降低的实现。

groups.label: k 的边擦释放

groups.label: t 的边＋中央释放
groups.hint: t 释放时中央与舌侧同时出现摩擦。

groups.label: d 的边＋中央释放
groups.hint: d 释放时中央与舌侧同时出现浊摩擦。

groups.label: 清舌唇塞擦音

groups.label: 浊舌唇塞擦音
groups.hint: 舌唇塞音连续释放为舌唇浊擦音。

groups.label: 清舌背软腭塞音
groups.hint: 软腭向舌背下压或反向接触形成的特殊软腭闭塞（velodorsal），常见于腭裂等临床语音描写，用专用扩展字母与普通 k 区分。

groups.label: 浊舌背软腭塞音
groups.hint: 对应软腭向舌背反向闭塞（velodorsal）的浊音形式，常见于临床语音描写。

groups.label: 舌背软腭鼻音
groups.hint: 相应软腭向舌背反向闭塞（velodorsal）伴随鼻腔气流。

groups.label: 舌下下齿龈叩击音
groups.hint: 舌下表面与下齿龈区域碰击，区别于普通舌尖齿龈塞音。

groups.label: 带舌下叩击释放的齿龈吸气音
groups.hint: 齿龈吸气音释放结合舌下叩击成分。

groups.label: 颊气流齿间颤音
groups.hint: 由颊腔气体驱动齿间颤动，原表称 raspberry。

groups.label: 双齿送气 t
groups.hint: t 的送气经过上下齿形成的通道，双齿记号修饰送气成分。

groups.label: 暂无可用符号的声音

entries.descriptionZh: 清双唇爆发音以两唇为主要构音部位，完全阻塞气流后解除阻塞。典型实现不伴随声带周期振动。表中的位置给出宽式分类，具体舌形、时长及协同发音需按材料补充。
entries.descriptionEn: The voiceless bilabial plosive is articulated primarily with both lips; airflow is completely blocked and then released. entries.descriptionZh: 清龈爆发音以舌尖或舌叶与齿龈为主要构音部位，完全阻塞气流后解除阻塞。典型实现不伴随声带周期振动。表中的位置给出宽式分类，具体舌形、时长及协同发音需按材料补充。中文版中除擦音外的齿、龈、龈后三栏共用相应基本符号；本扩展矩阵以龈栏为导航锚点，具体部位可用附加符号细化。
entries.descriptionEn: The voiceless alveolar plosive is articulated primarily with the tongue tip or blade and alveolar ridge; airflow is completely blocked and then released. Typical realizations have no periodic vocal-fold vibration. Chart positions give broad categories. Add details of tongue shape, duration and coarticulation for the material being transcribed. In the Chinese chart, dental, alveolar and postalveolar columns share the corresponding basic symbols except for fricatives; this expanded matrix uses the alveolar column as its navigation anchor. Refine place with diacritics as needed.

entries.descriptionZh: 喉爆发音以声门为主要构音部位，声门完全阻塞后解除阻塞；阻塞期间声带不振动，生理上既非清音亦非浊音。表中的位置给出宽式分类，具体实现与时长需按材料补充。
entries.descriptionEn: The glottal plosive is articulated primarily at the glottis, where complete closure blocks airflow before release; during closure the vocal folds do not vibrate, so physiologically it is neither voiced nor voiceless. Chart positions give broad categories. Add details of realization and duration for the material being transcribed.
entries.usageZh: 点击插入完整序列；有选区时替换选区。字符保存和复制均保持本条所列码位。
entries.usageEn: Click to insert the complete sequence; a selection is replaced when present. Saving and copying preserve the listed code points.
entries.contrastZh: 15×13 扩展矩阵将喉部构音（Laryngeal Articulations）分为喉（开）、喉（闭）与上喉（咽）三栏：h 与 ɦ 位于声门开放的喉（开）栏，ʔ 位于声门完全闭合的喉（闭）栏，因此 ʔ 无清浊对立。
entries.contrastEn: The 15×13 extended matrix divides Laryngeal Articulations into glottal (open), glottal (closed), and epilaryngeal (pharyngeal): h and ɦ lie in the open-glottis column, whereas ʔ lies in the closed-glottis column and has no voicing contrast.

entries.descriptionZh: 浊龈鼻音以舌尖或舌叶与齿龈为主要构音部位，口腔形成阻塞，软腭下降使气流通过鼻腔。典型实现伴随声带振动。表中的位置给出宽式分类，具体舌形、时长及协同发音需按材料补充。中文版中除擦音外的齿、龈、龈后三栏共用相应基本符号；本扩展矩阵以龈栏为导航锚点，具体部位可用附加符号细化。
entries.descriptionEn: The voiced alveolar nasal is articulated primarily with the tongue tip or blade and alveolar ridge; the oral cavity is closed and the lowered velum allows nasal airflow. Typical realizations include vocal-fold vibration. Chart positions give broad categories. Add details of tongue shape, duration and coarticulation for the material being transcribed. In the Chinese chart, dental, alveolar and postalveolar columns share the corresponding basic symbols except for fricatives; this expanded matrix uses the alveolar column as its navigation anchor. Refine place with diacritics as needed.

entries.descriptionEn: The voiced retroflex nasal is articulated primarily with the tongue tip curled upward to contact or approach the front hard palate / postalveolar region; the oral cavity is closed and the lowered velum allows nasal airflow. entries.descriptionZh: 浊龈颤音以舌尖或舌叶与齿龈为主要构音部位，活动发音器官在气流作用下发生重复接触。典型实现伴随声带振动。表中的位置给出宽式分类，具体舌形、时长及协同发音需按材料补充。中文版中除擦音外的齿、龈、龈后三栏共用相应基本符号；本扩展矩阵以龈栏为导航锚点，具体部位可用附加符号细化。
entries.descriptionEn: The voiced alveolar trill is articulated primarily with the tongue tip or blade and alveolar ridge; airflow causes repeated contact of the active articulator. Typical realizations include vocal-fold vibration. Chart positions give broad categories. Add details of tongue shape, duration and coarticulation for the material being transcribed. In the Chinese chart, dental, alveolar and postalveolar columns share the corresponding basic symbols except for fricatives; this expanded matrix uses the alveolar column as its navigation anchor. Refine place with diacritics as needed.

entries.descriptionEn: The voiced postalveolar fricative is articulated primarily with the tongue and the postalveolar region; a narrow passage generates turbulent friction noise. entries.descriptionZh: 清喉擦音以声门为主要构音部位，构成狭窄通道，使气流产生摩擦噪声。典型实现不伴随声带周期振动。表中的位置给出宽式分类，具体舌形、时长及协同发音需按材料补充。
entries.descriptionEn: The voiceless glottal fricative is articulated primarily with the glottis; a narrow passage generates turbulent friction noise. entries.contrastZh: 15×13 扩展矩阵将喉部构音（Laryngeal Articulations）分为喉（开）、喉（闭）与上喉（咽）三栏：h 与 ɦ 位于声门开放的喉（开）栏，ʔ 位于声门完全闭合的喉（闭）栏，因此 ʔ 无清浊对立。
entries.contrastEn: The 15×13 extended matrix divides Laryngeal Articulations into glottal (open), glottal (closed), and epilaryngeal (pharyngeal): h and ɦ lie in the open-glottis column, whereas ʔ lies in the closed-glottis column and has no voicing contrast.

entries.descriptionZh: 浊软腭近音以舌后部与软腭为主要构音部位，发音器官接近，但通常不产生持续的强摩擦。典型实现伴随声带振动。表中的位置给出宽式分类，具体舌形、时长及协同发音需按材料补充。
entries.descriptionEn: The voiced velar approximant is articulated primarily with the back of the tongue and soft palate; the articulators approach, usually without sustained strong friction. Typical realizations include vocal-fold vibration. Chart positions give broad categories. Add details of tongue shape, duration and coarticulation for the material being transcribed.

entries.descriptionZh: 浊龈边近音以舌尖或舌叶与齿龈为主要构音部位，中央受阻，气流沿舌侧通过而不产生强摩擦。典型实现伴随声带振动。表中的位置给出宽式分类，具体舌形、时长及协同发音需按材料补充。中文版中除擦音外的齿、龈、龈后三栏共用相应基本符号；本扩展矩阵以龈栏为导航锚点，具体部位可用附加符号细化。
entries.descriptionEn: The voiced alveolar lateral approximant is articulated primarily with the tongue tip or blade and alveolar ridge; the central passage is blocked and airflow passes along the tongue sides without strong friction. Typical realizations include vocal-fold vibration. Chart positions give broad categories. Add details of tongue shape, duration and coarticulation for the material being transcribed. In the Chinese chart, dental, alveolar and postalveolar columns share the corresponding basic symbols except for fricatives; this expanded matrix uses the alveolar column as its navigation anchor. Refine place with diacritics as needed.

entries.descriptionZh: 用舌前后（双唇音包括唇部）两处闭塞形成腔体，扩大腔体后释放前部闭塞，形成双唇啧音。这里的符号标前部释放类型；需要时另记后部闭塞和发声类型。
entries.descriptionEn: Two closures, front and back (including the lips for bilabials), enclose a cavity. Its expansion followed by anterior release produces the bilabial click. The symbol identifies the anterior release type; record posterior closure and phonation type separately as needed.
entries.usageZh: 点击插入完整序列；有选区时替换选区。字符保存和复制均保持本条所列码位。
entries.usageEn: Click to insert the complete sequence; a selection is replaced when present. Saving and copying preserve the listed code points.
entries.contrastZh: 啧音采用舌气流机制，前后闭塞间腔体扩大后释放前部闭塞；与肺部吸气言语区分。ǃ是音标字母，不能以普通感叹号替换。
entries.contrastEn: Clicks use a lingual airstream mechanism: expansion of the cavity between two closures precedes anterior release; distinguish them from pulmonic ingressive speech. ǃ is an IPA letter and cannot be replaced by an ordinary exclamation mark.

entries.descriptionZh: 表示双唇部位的浊内爆音。闭塞阶段喉部降低，形成喉部内向气流机制，常伴声带振动；实际口腔气流方向可能随语言和实现变化。
entries.descriptionEn: A voiced implosive at the bilabial place of articulation. The larynx lowers during closure, producing a glottalic ingressive mechanism, often with vocal-fold vibration; actual oral airflow direction may vary across languages and realizations.

entries.contrastZh: 内爆音与喉部上升形成的喷音相区别；也不同于肺部吸气言语。
entries.contrastEn: Implosives differ from ejectives produced by raising the larynx; they also differ from pulmonic ingressive speech.

entries.descriptionZh: 用舌前后（双唇音包括唇部）两处闭塞形成腔体，扩大腔体后释放前部闭塞，形成龈(后)啧音。这里的符号标前部释放类型；需要时另记后部闭塞和发声类型。本 15×13 扩展矩阵依图面体例将其与齿龈边啧音 ǁ 同置于龈栏。
entries.descriptionEn: Two closures, front and back (including the lips for bilabials), enclose a cavity. Its expansion followed by anterior release produces the postalveolar click. The symbol identifies the anterior release type; record posterior closure and phonation type separately as needed. Following Figure 1 layout conventions, this 15×13 extended matrix places it in the alveolar column alongside the alveolar lateral click ǁ.
entries.usageZh: 点击插入完整序列；有选区时替换选区。字符保存和复制均保持本条所列码位。
entries.usageEn: Click to insert the complete sequence; a selection is replaced when present. Saving and copying preserve the listed code points.
entries.contrastZh: 啧音采用舌气流机制，前后闭塞间腔体扩大后释放前部闭塞；与肺部吸气言语区分。ǃ是音标字母，不能以普通感叹号替换。
entries.contrastEn: Clicks use a lingual airstream mechanism: expansion of the cavity between two closures precedes anterior release; distinguish them from pulmonic ingressive speech. ǃ is an IPA letter and cannot be replaced by an ordinary exclamation mark.

entries.descriptionEn: Two closures, front and back (including the lips for bilabials), enclose a cavity. Its expansion followed by anterior release produces the alveolar lateral click. The symbol identifies the anterior release type; record posterior closure and phonation type separately as needed.
entries.usageZh: 点击插入完整序列；有选区时替换选区。字符保存和复制均保持本条所列码位。
entries.usageEn: Click to insert the complete sequence; a selection is replaced when present. Saving and copying preserve the listed code points.
entries.contrastZh: 啧音采用舌气流机制，前后闭塞间腔体扩大后释放前部闭塞；与肺部吸气言语区分。ǃ是音标字母，不能以普通感叹号替换。
entries.contrastEn: Clicks use a lingual airstream mechanism: expansion of the cavity between two closures precedes anterior release; distinguish them from pulmonic ingressive speech. ǃ is an IPA letter and cannot be replaced by an ordinary exclamation mark.

entries.descriptionZh: 表示小舌部位的浊内爆音。闭塞阶段喉部降低，形成喉部内向气流机制，常伴声带振动；实际口腔气流方向可能随语言和实现变化。

entries.contrastEn: Implosives differ from ejectives produced by raising the larynx; they also differ from pulmonic ingressive speech.

entries.nameZh: 会厌清颤音（会厌清擦音）
entries.descriptionZh: 在会厌／杓会厌区域形成的清音。官方 IPA 原表（2005/2026）将其列于“其他符号”作为会厌清擦音；现代喉镜与声学研究表明其典型实现伴随杓状会厌襞颤动，本 15×13 扩展矩阵据此置于颤音行。
entries.descriptionEn: A voiceless consonant articulated in the epiglottal / aryepiglottic region. Official IPA charts (2005/2026) list it under Other Symbols as a voiceless epiglottal fricative; modern laryngoscopic and acoustic studies show typical realizations involve aryepiglottic fold trilling, so this 15×13 extended matrix places it in the trill row.
entries.usageZh: 点击插入完整序列；有选区时替换选区。字符保存和复制均保持本条所列码位。
entries.usageEn: Click to insert the complete sequence; a selection is replaced when present. Saving and copying preserve the listed code points.
entries.contrastZh: 核对纸本官方 IPA 表时须注意两套口径：官方原表归入“其他符号”（会厌清擦音），与上喉（咽）清擦音 ħ 邻近；现代咽喉构音研究常依其颤动生理特征归入颤音，与无颤动的 ħ 区分。
entries.contrastEn: When checking printed official IPA charts, note both conventions: the official chart places ʜ in Other Symbols (voiceless epiglottal fricative) near pharyngeal ħ, whereas modern laryngeal-articulatory charts classify it as a trill distinguished from non-trilled ħ.

entries.descriptionZh: 为元音标记 r 类音色，不指定唯一舌形。
entries.descriptionEn: Marks rhotic quality in a vowel without specifying a unique tongue shape.
entries.usageZh: 标明 r 音色。普通话儿化可有舌尖上卷型或舌尖向下、舌体聚拢型；韵尾脱落、鼻化及音色变化由具体方言词项决定。可在个人套装中保存同一音标的实测构型。
entries.usageEn: Click to insert the complete sequence; a selection is replaced when present. Saving and copying preserve the listed code points.
entries.contrastZh: r音色描述听觉性质。舌尖后卷和团舌等不同舌形都可能产生相关音色，不能从此符号唯一反推出舌形。
entries.contrastEn: Rhoticity describes an auditory quality. Retroflex and bunched tongue shapes can both produce this quality; the symbol does not uniquely identify tongue shape.

entries.descriptionZh: 使元音舌位更高，或使辅音狭窄程度增大。
entries.descriptionEn: Raises vowel tongue position or increases consonant constriction.
entries.usageZh: 元音 [e̝] 比基准 [e] 更闭；[ɹ̝] 则缩小主狭窄，可出现齿龈摩擦。两者都不要求提高音高或喉位。
entries.usageEn: Insert after the base letter. The button inserts only the diacritic; the dotted display circle is not inserted.
entries.contrastZh: 偏高、偏低可改变元音舌位，也可改变辅音的狭窄程度；ɹ̝可用于更强摩擦的实现，β̞可用于近音实现。
entries.contrastEn: Raising/lowering can change vowel position or consonant constriction; ɹ̝ can denote a more fricated realization; β̞ can denote an approximant.

entries.usageEn: Insert after the base letter. The button inserts only the diacritic; the dotted display circle is not inserted.

entries.contrastEn: No audible release means that no separate release burst is heard. Release may occur nasally, laterally or into the next segment; the symbol does not establish that release never occurred.

entries.descriptionEn: Voiceless labiodental plosive. Forms a complete closure followed by release. Interpret this combination using extIPA places and manners of articulation; combined diacritics form part of the full transcription and must not be discarded during copying.

entries.contrastEn: The marker describes an observed phonetic feature. The symbol alone does not identify a cause or clinical diagnosis.

entries.descriptionZh: 清腭咽颤音。腭咽闭合不全时气流经腭咽口驱动软腭与咽壁发生颤动或喷气震颤。该组合按 extIPA 的发音部位和方式解释；组合附加记号属于整体转写的一部分，不应在复制时丢弃。
entries.descriptionEn: Voiceless velopharyngeal trill. entries.descriptionZh: 双唇叩击音。两发音器官相撞产生叩击声，不能把符号解释为普通肺部塞音。该组合按 extIPA 的发音部位和方式解释；组合附加记号属于整体转写的一部分，不应在复制时丢弃。
entries.descriptionEn: Bilabial percussive. Two articulators collide to make a percussive sound. Do not interpret the symbol as an ordinary pulmonic stop. Interpret this combination using extIPA places and manners of articulation; combined diacritics form part of the full transcription and must not be discarded during copying.

entries.usageZh: 在基底字母之后输入。按钮仅写入附加记号，显示用的虚线圆不进入文本。
entries.usageEn: Insert after the base letter. The button inserts only the diacritic; the dotted display circle is not inserted.
entries.contrastZh: 此记号描述观察到的语音特征，单凭符号不能推出病因或临床诊断。
entries.contrastEn: The marker describes an observed phonetic feature. The symbol alone does not identify a cause or clinical diagnosis.

entries.descriptionZh: 只能把声音可靠归入辅音这一类别，不能确定更细的音值。圈内字母是类别占位记号，不能把大写字母照普通字母音值读出。
entries.descriptionEn: The sound can be reliably classified only as consonant; a more precise phonetic value cannot be determined. Letters within circles are category placeholders. Do not read their capitals as ordinary IPA sound values.

entries.contrastZh: 圈围表示辨识不确定性；附加在小写基底上的清化小圆表示发声特征，二者功能不同。
entries.contrastEn: Enclosures indicate uncertainty of identification; the small devoicing ring on a lowercase base marks phonation. Their functions differ.

entries.descriptionZh: 通过压缩面颊和口腔内的空气驱动发声，舌或唇可参与振动。常见于模仿声、吐舌声等短声音，也可用于短段言语。
entries.descriptionEn: Phonation driven by compressing air in the cheeks and oral cavity; the tongue or lips may vibrate. It commonly occurs in short imitative sounds and tongue-out sounds, and can also support brief stretches of speech.
entries.usageZh: 用 ↀ 标出采用颊气流的片段，连续转写时可写成 {ↀ … ↀ}。
entries.usageEn: Use ↀ to mark stretches produced with a buccal airstream. In continuous transcription, write {ↀ … ↀ}.
entries.contrastZh: 这里标记气流的动力来源。颊气流与肺部呼气、吸气及食管气流分别记录。
entries.contrastEn: This marks the source of airstream power. Buccal, pulmonic egressive, pulmonic ingressive, and oesophageal airstreams are recorded separately.

entries.descriptionZh: 在肺部吸气过程中发出的言语，气流从口鼻向肺部流入。吸气时的惊叹声，以及交替呼气、吸气连续数数，都可出现这种气流方式。
entries.descriptionEn: Speech produced during inhalation, with air flowing from the mouth and nose toward the lungs. Inhaled exclamations and continuous counting with alternating exhalation and inhalation can use this airstream.
entries.usageZh: ↓ 可跟在单个音标后，也可用 {↓ … ↓} 标出一整段吸气言语。
entries.usageEn: ↓ may follow an individual phonetic symbol; {↓ … ↓} can mark a complete stretch of ingressive speech.
entries.contrastZh: 肺部吸气与内爆音的喉部气流机制不同。这个向下箭头也不表示降调。
entries.contrastEn: Pulmonic ingression differs from the laryngeal airstream mechanism of implosives. This downward arrow also does not indicate falling tone.

entries.descriptionZh: 食管言语先将空气引入食管，再释放空气，使咽与食管交界处的组织振动，形成替代声门的声源。口腔、舌和唇等继续参与调音。
entries.descriptionEn: Oesophageal speech introduces air into the oesophagus and then releases it, vibrating tissue at the pharyngo-oesophageal junction to provide an alternative to the glottal source. The oral cavity, tongue, and lips continue to articulate.
entries.usageZh: 用 Œ 或带 Œ 标签的大括号记录食管气流的作用范围。Œ 来自 oesophageal 的开头字母 OE。
entries.usageEn: Use Œ or braces labelled Œ to show the scope of oesophageal airflow. Œ comes from the initial OE of oesophageal.
entries.contrastZh: 食管内储存的空气提供动力。气管–食管言语则把肺部呼出的气流引入食管。这里的大写 Œ 与元音 œ 用途不同。
entries.contrastEn: Air stored in the oesophagus supplies the power. Tracheo-oesophageal speech instead directs exhaled pulmonic air into the oesophagus. Capital Œ here has a different function from the vowel œ.

entries.descriptionZh: 肺部呼出的气流经气管与食管之间的通道进入食管，驱动咽–食管交界处的组织振动，再经喉上声道调音。
entries.descriptionEn: Exhaled pulmonic air enters the oesophagus through a passage between the trachea and oesophagus, driving vibration at the pharyngo-oesophageal junction before supralaryngeal articulation.
entries.usageZh: 用 Ю 标出气管–食管言语，连续范围可写成 {Ю … Ю}。
entries.usageEn: Use Ю for tracheo-oesophageal speech; a continuous stretch can be written {Ю … Ю}.
entries.contrastZh: 它与食管言语可利用相近的替代声源，但气流动力来自肺部，可支持较长的连续发声。
entries.contrastEn: It can use an alternative sound source similar to oesophageal speech, but its driving airflow comes from the lungs and can sustain longer stretches of phonation.

entries.descriptionZh: 日常说话和歌唱中常用的发声类型，以声带较规则的周期振动产生声音。在 VoQS 中，V 与 F、W、C 并列为四个基本发声标签，也作为多种复合发声类型的基底。
entries.descriptionEn: A phonation type common in everyday speech and singing, producing sound through relatively regular periodic vocal-fold vibration. In VoQS, V is one of four basic phonation labels alongside F, W, and C, and underlies several compound phonation types.
entries.usageZh: 用 V 标记常态浊声，需要界定连续范围时写成 {V … V}。
entries.usageEn: Use V for modal voice; write {V … V} when a continuous stretch needs to be delimited.
entries.contrastZh: 常态浊声的音高范围随说话人而变。常态是发声类型的名称，其他发声类型同样可以用于健康、自然的言语。
entries.contrastEn: The pitch range of modal voice varies between speakers. Modal names a phonation type; other phonation types can also occur in healthy, natural speech.

entries.descriptionZh: 声带纵向拉长，振动边缘变薄，参与振动的组织量减少，通常产生较高、较轻薄的声音。假声可伴随漏气，也可与耳语、嘎裂或糙声性质组合。
entries.descriptionEn: The vocal folds lengthen longitudinally, their vibrating edges become thinner, and less tissue participates in vibration, usually producing a higher, lighter sound. Falsetto may be leaky and may combine with whispery, creaky, or harsh qualities.
entries.usageZh: F 表示假声，单下点、下波浪号和叹号可进一步标出它所带的耳语、嘎裂与粗糙性质。
entries.usageEn: F marks falsetto. A dot below, a tilde below, and an exclamation mark further indicate whispery, creaky, and harsh qualities respectively.
entries.contrastZh: 假声与常态浊声的音高范围可以重叠，应结合发声方式和听感区分。假声使用声带发声，与室襞性发声中的假声带是两个概念。
entries.contrastEn: Falsetto and modal voice can overlap in pitch; distinguish them using phonatory configuration and auditory quality together. Falsetto uses the vocal folds; the false vocal folds involved in ventricular phonation are a separate concept.

entries.descriptionZh: 气流经过收窄的喉部通道产生湍流噪声，声带缺少持续的周期振动。典型耳语伴随喉部收缩，声门前部靠拢、后部保留开口，可呈近似 Y 形。
entries.descriptionEn: Airflow through a narrowed laryngeal passage produces turbulence noise without sustained periodic vocal-fold vibration. Typical whisper includes laryngeal constriction, with the anterior glottis approximated and a posterior opening, potentially resembling a Y shape.
entries.usageZh: 用 W 标记耳语。耳语范围中的清辅音仍按各自音值转写，标签概括整段的发声设置。
entries.usageEn: Use W for whisper. Voiceless consonants within a whispered stretch retain their individual phonetic transcriptions; the label summarizes the stretch's phonatory setting.
entries.contrastZh: 耳语 W 以气流噪声为主要声源。耳语声 Ṿ 保留耳语设置，同时有声带振动。耳语也可有较大的响度。
entries.contrastEn: Whisper W primarily uses airflow noise as its sound source. Whispery voice Ṿ retains the whisper setting with vocal-fold vibration added. Whisper can also be relatively loud.

entries.descriptionZh: 以缓慢、可辨的声带脉冲为突出特征，听起来类似连续的细小爆裂或敲击声。常见振动频率较低、气流较少，脉冲间隔可以规则，也可以不规则。
entries.descriptionEn: Slow, distinguishable vocal-fold pulses are prominent, sounding like a series of small crackles or taps. Vibration is commonly low in frequency with little airflow; pulse spacing may be regular or irregular.
entries.usageZh: C 是 VoQS 的基本发声标签之一，表示嘎裂；叹号可进一步标出糙嘎裂 C!。
entries.usageEn: C is one of VoQS's basic phonation labels and denotes creak. Add an exclamation mark for harsh creak C!.
entries.contrastZh: VoQS 将嘎裂 C 与嘎裂声 V̰ 分列，后者表示浊声带有嘎裂性质。两类实际表现可以相近，使用时保持同一套转写标准。
entries.contrastEn: VoQS lists creak C separately from creaky voice V̰, the latter indicating voicing with creaky qualities. Their realizations can be similar; use a consistent transcription standard.

entries.descriptionZh: 在耳语的喉部设置中加入声带振动，声音同时包含带声成分和较明显的气流摩擦噪声。喉部收缩与后部气流通道共同参与这种音质。
entries.descriptionEn: Vocal-fold vibration is added to the laryngeal setting of whisper, combining voiced energy with appreciable airflow-friction noise. Laryngeal constriction and the posterior airflow passage jointly shape this voice quality.
entries.usageZh: V 下加单点表示耳语声，可用 {Ṿ … Ṿ} 标记连续片段。
entries.usageEn: A single dot below V marks whispery voice; use {Ṿ … Ṿ} for a continuous stretch.
entries.contrastZh: 与耳语 W 相比，耳语声有声带振动；与气声 V̤ 相比，其喉部通常更收紧，湍流噪声也更突出。单下点与双下点分别使用。
entries.contrastEn: Unlike whisper W, whispery voice includes vocal-fold vibration. Compared with breathy voice V̤, its larynx is usually more constricted and its turbulence more prominent. A single dot below and two dots below are distinct marks.

entries.descriptionZh: 浊声中带有嘎裂的脉冲性质，可表现为低频振动、多脉冲或不规则振动，听感常有颗粒感和断续感。不同说话人和语境中的嘎裂声可以具有不同的振动模式。
entries.descriptionEn: Voicing has creaky pulses, potentially including low-frequency vibration, multiple pulses, or irregular vibration, often heard as grainy or intermittent. Creaky voice may have different vibratory patterns across speakers and contexts.
entries.usageZh: 在 V 下加波浪号表示嘎裂声。C 单列嘎裂这一基本类型，V̰ 用于带嘎裂性质的浊声。
entries.usageEn: A tilde below V indicates creaky voice. C separately labels creak as a basic type, whereas V̰ labels voicing with creaky qualities.
entries.contrastZh: 低音高是常见表现，但基频高低本身不能概括所有嘎裂声。嘎裂声与糙声可组合，分别用下波浪号和叹号记录。
entries.contrastEn: Low pitch is common, but fundamental frequency alone does not characterize every kind of creaky voice. Creaky and harsh qualities can combine, marked separately by a tilde below and an exclamation mark.

entries.descriptionZh: 声带振动的同时有较多气流逸出，周期性声音中混有呼气般的气流声。典型设置中声门闭合较不充分，喉上通道相对开放。
entries.descriptionEn: Considerable airflow escapes during vocal-fold vibration, mixing a breath-like airflow sound with periodic sound. A typical setting has less complete glottal closure and a relatively open supralaryngeal passage.
entries.usageZh: 在 V 下加双点表示气声；标记单个音段时，也可在相应 IPA 字母下加气声符。
entries.usageEn: Two dots below V mark breathy voice. For an individual segment, the breathy-voice diacritic can instead be placed below the corresponding IPA letter.
entries.contrastZh: 气声 V̤ 与耳语声 Ṿ 都有声带振动。气声的喉部通常较开放，耳语声则带有耳语式收缩。双下点不表示一个另行跟随的送气音段。
entries.contrastEn: Breathy V̤ and whispery Ṿ voice both include vocal-fold vibration. Breathy voice usually has a more open laryngeal setting; whispery voice has whisper-like constriction. Two dots below do not denote a separate following aspirated segment.

entries.descriptionZh: 带有明显粗糙感的发声，常伴喉部收缩、振动不规则和噪声增加。杓状会厌区域及室襞的收缩可参与形成这种音质；低音调糙声还可伴随杓状会厌襞振动。
entries.descriptionEn: Phonation with marked harshness, often involving laryngeal constriction, irregular vibration, and increased noise. Aryepiglottic and ventricular constriction may contribute; low-pitched harsh voice may also involve aryepiglottic-fold vibration.
entries.usageZh: V 后加 ! 表示糙声，用 {V! … V!} 标出范围。1、2、3 可标记由弱到强的相对粗糙程度。
entries.usageEn: Add ! after V for harsh voice; {V! … V!} marks its scope. 1, 2, and 3 may mark relative harshness from weaker to stronger.
entries.contrastZh: 糙声可出现在低、中、高音区。叹号标记粗糙性质，响度需另行记录；若要明确室襞参与振动，可使用室襞性发声的标签 V‼。
entries.contrastEn: Harsh voice can occur at low, middle, or high pitch. The exclamation mark denotes harshness; record loudness separately. Use ventricular phonation V‼ when ventricular-fold vibration needs explicit identification.

entries.descriptionZh: 假声与耳语性质结合的复合发声类型。假声的声带振动同时伴随耳语式喉部收缩和气流摩擦噪声。
entries.descriptionEn: A compound phonation type combining falsetto with whispery qualities. Falsetto vocal-fold vibration co-occurs with whisper-like laryngeal constriction and airflow-friction noise.
entries.usageZh: F 表示假声，单下点表示耳语性质，两个部分共同构成 F̣。
entries.usageEn: F denotes falsetto and a dot below denotes whispery quality; together they form F̣.
entries.contrastZh: 与耳语声 Ṿ 的区别在于采用假声设置。假声中单纯的漏气可表现为气声性质，需与这里的耳语性质分开。
entries.contrastEn: It differs from whispery voice Ṿ in using a falsetto setting. Simple air leakage in falsetto can be breathy and should be distinguished from the whispery quality marked here.

entries.descriptionEn: Falsetto with creaky qualities, adding a pulsed or irregular auditory character to the lighter falsetto sound. VoQS lists it as a compound phonation type.
entries.usageZh: F 表示假声，下波浪号表示嘎裂性质，组合为 F̰。
entries.usageEn: F denotes falsetto and the tilde below denotes creaky quality, giving F̰.
entries.contrastZh: 该标签记录同一片段内两种性质的结合。若只是先嘎裂、后假声，应分别标出两个连续范围。
entries.contrastEn: This label records both qualities within the same stretch. If creak is simply followed by falsetto, mark two separate successive stretches.

entries.descriptionEn: Falsetto with harsh qualities, containing appreciable noise or irregular vibration.
entries.usageZh: 在 F 后加 !，表示假声与糙声性质的组合 F!。
entries.usageEn: Add ! after F for the combination of falsetto and harsh qualities, F!.
entries.contrastZh: F 决定假声这一基本设置，! 补充粗糙性质。高音区中的声音只有具备这两项特征时才使用本标签。
entries.contrastEn: F specifies the basic falsetto setting and ! adds harshness. Use this label for high-pitched sounds only when both features are present.

entries.descriptionZh: 在嘎裂的缓慢脉冲性发声基础上，叠加更明显的粗糙性质。它保留嘎裂这一基本类型，同时记录糙声特征。
entries.descriptionEn: More pronounced harshness is added to creak's slow-pulsed phonation. The basic creak type is retained while harsh qualities are also recorded.
entries.usageZh: C 表示嘎裂，! 表示粗糙性质，合写为 C!。
entries.usageEn: C denotes creak and ! denotes harshness; together they form C!.
entries.contrastZh: C! 与糙嘎裂声 V̰! 沿用 C 和 V̰ 的区分，转写时应与单独使用嘎裂、嘎裂声标签的标准一致。
entries.contrastEn: C! and harsh creaky voice V̰! retain the distinction between C and V̰. Apply the same criteria used for separate creak and creaky-voice labels.

entries.descriptionZh: 带声的耳语式发声同时具有粗糙感。声带振动、耳语式气流噪声与糙声性质在同一片段中结合。
entries.descriptionEn: Voiced whisper-like phonation also has a harsh quality. Vocal-fold vibration, whisper-like airflow noise, and harshness combine in the same stretch.
entries.usageZh: V 下的单点表示耳语性质，后面的 ! 表示粗糙性质，写作 Ṿ!。
entries.usageEn: The dot below V denotes whispery quality and the following ! denotes harshness: Ṿ!.
entries.contrastZh: 与耳语声 Ṿ 相比，多标记粗糙性质；与糙声 V! 相比，明确保留耳语性质。
entries.contrastEn: Compared with whispery voice Ṿ, it adds harshness. Compared with harsh voice V!, it explicitly retains whispery quality.

entries.descriptionEn: Voicing combines creaky pulses and harshness, heard as both creaky graininess and harsh roughness.
entries.usageZh: V 下的波浪号表示嘎裂，! 表示粗糙性质，组合为 V̰!。

entries.contrastEn: Creakiness and harshness are recorded separately. If only one is present, use V̰ or V! as appropriate.

entries.descriptionEn: Whispery creaky voice with additional harshness, combining voicing, whisper-like noise, creaky pulses, and harsh qualities.
entries.usageZh: V 为基底，下波浪号表示嘎裂，单下点表示耳语，! 表示粗糙性质。

entries.contrastEn: Compared with whispery creaky voice V̰̣, this label additionally marks harshness. Every component should correspond to an actual feature in the transcribed stretch.

entries.descriptionZh: 相对较松弛的发声设置，可带有较少的喉部挤压感。松、紧描述的是相对于参照状态的发声紧张程度，实际可涉及不同的喉部调整。
entries.descriptionEn: A relatively relaxed phonatory setting, potentially with less laryngeal squeezing. Lax and tense describe tension relative to a reference setting and may involve different laryngeal adjustments.
entries.usageZh: V 下加弱构音附加号表示弛声或松声，判断时采用一致的参照。
entries.usageEn: The weak-articulation diacritic below V marks lax voice. Use a consistent reference when judging it.
entries.contrastZh: 弛声与紧声 V͈ 相对。响度、漏气和紧张程度可分别变化，若有明确的气声或耳语性质，可另外记录。
entries.contrastEn: Lax voice contrasts with tense voice V͈. Loudness, air leakage, and tension can vary independently; clear breathy or whispery qualities may be recorded separately.

entries.descriptionZh: 相对较紧、带挤压感或用力感的发声设置（pressed phonation / 紧声），常涉及声带较强内收及喉部收缩。紧声这一标签概括发声表现，具体收缩部位可进一步说明。
entries.descriptionEn: A relatively tense, pressed, or effortful phonatory setting (pressed phonation / tight voice), often involving stronger vocal-fold adduction and laryngeal constriction. Pressed phonation summarizes the phonatory presentation; the specific constriction site may be described further.
entries.usageZh: V 下加强构音附加号，表示挤喉发声或紧声。
entries.usageEn: The strong-articulation diacritic below V marks pressed or tense voice.
entries.contrastZh: 紧声与弛声 V͉ 相对。此处的“挤喉发声”指声门与喉部挤紧的持续发声设置，不同于非肺部外向气流机制的喷音（挤喉音）。紧张程度和粗糙程度是不同观察维度，明显的嘎裂或糙声性质可分别记录。
entries.contrastEn: Tight or pressed phonation contrasts with lax voice V͉. Here "pressed phonation" refers to a sustained phonatory setting with glottal adduction and laryngeal constriction, distinct from glottalic egressive ejectives in non-pulmonic consonants. Tension and roughness are different observational dimensions; clear creaky or harsh qualities can be recorded separately.

entries.descriptionZh: 室襞又称假声带，因此也称假声带发声。室襞位于声带上方，受气流驱动而振动并参与形成声源，下方声带可同时振动。
entries.descriptionEn: The ventricular folds are also called the false vocal folds, hence false-vocal-fold phonation. Located above the vocal folds, they vibrate in the airflow and contribute to the sound source; the vocal folds below may vibrate simultaneously.
entries.usageZh: V 后的双叹号 ‼ 标记室襞性发声。需要记录持续片段时使用 {V‼ … V‼}。
entries.usageEn: The double exclamation mark ‼ after V marks ventricular phonation. Use {V‼ … V‼} for a sustained stretch.
entries.contrastZh: 室襞性发声明确涉及室襞振动。糙声 V! 概括粗糙性质；假声 F 则采用声带的假声振动设置。
entries.contrastEn: Ventricular phonation explicitly involves ventricular-fold vibration. Harsh voice V! summarizes roughness, whereas falsetto F uses a falsetto pattern of vocal-fold vibration.

entries.descriptionZh: 也称双音调嗓音，听觉上可辨认出同时存在的两个音高成分。声带与室襞共同振动可以产生这种表现，声带不对称或复杂振动模式也可能形成类似音质。
entries.descriptionEn: Also called double-pitched voice, with two pitch components heard simultaneously. Joint vocal-fold and ventricular-fold vibration can produce it; vocal-fold asymmetry or complex vibratory patterns may also produce a similar quality.
entries.usageZh: 在室襞性发声标签 V‼ 下加浊化符，构成 V̬‼。
entries.usageEn: Add the voicing diacritic below the ventricular-phonation label V‼ to form V̬‼.
entries.contrastZh: 复音强调两个同时可感知的音高。一般的粗糙感，以及基音和某个增强泛音共同突出的听感，需结合具体材料分别判断。
entries.contrastEn: Diplophonia emphasizes two simultaneously perceived pitches. General roughness and a percept in which the fundamental and an enhanced overtone are both prominent require separate assessment in the actual material.

entries.descriptionZh: 室襞振动参与发声，同时带有耳语性质，也可称耳语假声带发声。声音兼有室襞声源与耳语式气流噪声。
entries.descriptionEn: Ventricular-fold vibration contributes to phonation together with whispery quality; also called whispery false-vocal-fold phonation. The sound combines a ventricular source and whisper-like airflow noise.
entries.usageZh: 在 V‼ 下加单点，表示耳语性质与室襞性发声结合。
entries.usageEn: A dot below V‼ combines whispery quality with ventricular phonation.
entries.contrastZh: 与室襞性发声 V‼ 相比增加耳语性质，与耳语声 Ṿ 相比明确标出室襞振动的参与。
entries.contrastEn: It adds whisperiness to ventricular phonation V‼ and explicitly identifies ventricular-fold vibration compared with whispery voice Ṿ.

entries.descriptionZh: 杓状会厌襞在气流作用下振动，参与形成声源。这些组织位于喉入口处，其振动可与声带发声结合，也可参与低音调糙声。
entries.descriptionEn: The aryepiglottic folds vibrate in the airflow and contribute to the sound source. These tissues are at the laryngeal inlet; their vibration can combine with vocal-fold phonation and may contribute to low-pitched harsh voice.
entries.usageZh: V 后的上标小型大写 AA 标记杓状会厌襞这一振动来源。
entries.usageEn: Superscript small-capital AA after V marks the aryepiglottic folds as a vibrating source.
entries.contrastZh: 室襞与杓状会厌襞是不同结构，分别使用 V‼ 与本标签。具体振动来源需要结合喉部观察。
entries.contrastEn: The ventricular folds and aryepiglottic folds are different structures, marked by V‼ and this label respectively. Specific vibratory sources require laryngeal observation.

entries.descriptionZh: 用于记录痉挛性发声障碍相关的不规则音质波动或发声中断。符号形态表示交替、波动的状态，可概括一段言语中的变化。
entries.descriptionEn: Records irregular voice-quality fluctuations or phonatory breaks associated with spasmodic dysphonia. The symbol depicts alternation or fluctuation and may summarize changes across a stretch of speech.
entries.usageZh: 可单独使用，也可与其他音质标签配合标明变化的起止。内收型、外展型及是否伴震颤等信息可另作文字注释。
entries.usageEn: It can stand alone or combine with other voice-quality labels to delimit changes. Adductor/abductor type and the presence of tremor can be added as text annotations.
entries.contrastZh: 本符号不细分障碍类型，也不能单凭一次音质波动确定诊断。转写时记录已知情况和实际表现。
entries.contrastEn: This symbol does not distinguish disorder subtypes, and a single voice-quality fluctuation cannot establish a diagnosis. Record known circumstances and actual observations.

entries.descriptionZh: 由电子喉提供振动声源，再通过口腔、舌和唇等调音形成言语。使用者可控制装置的启停，配合清浊音的区别。
entries.descriptionEn: An electrolarynx provides vibration as the sound source, which is articulated into speech by the oral cavity, tongue, and lips. Users can start and stop the device to support voicing contrasts.
entries.usageZh: И 表示电子喉被用作发声的声源，使用范围标签时可涵盖相应言语片段。
entries.usageEn: И indicates that an electrolarynx serves as the source. A scope label may encompass the relevant stretch of speech.
entries.contrastZh: 范围内仍可有清音和停顿，无须理解为装置全程连续振动。食管言语和气管–食管言语使用人体组织作为替代声源。
entries.contrastEn: The stretch can still contain voiceless sounds and pauses; the device need not vibrate continuously throughout it. Oesophageal and tracheo-oesophageal speech instead use human tissue as an alternative sound source.

entries.descriptionZh: 言语中喉的位置相对偏高，声道长度和共鸣条件随之改变。L 表示喉，下方偏高符表示位置上移。
entries.descriptionEn: The larynx occupies a relatively high position during speech, changing vocal-tract length and resonance. L denotes the larynx, and the raising diacritic below indicates upward displacement.
entries.usageZh: 用 L̝ 标记升高的喉位，可与发声类型标签共同限定一个片段。
entries.usageEn: L̝ marks a raised larynx and can delimit a stretch jointly with a phonation-type label.
entries.contrastZh: 喉位高度与声带振动频率分别记录。喉位升高可伴随音高变化，但高音高本身不足以确定喉位。
entries.contrastEn: Larynx height and vocal-fold vibration frequency are recorded separately. A raised larynx may accompany pitch changes, but high pitch alone does not establish larynx position.

entries.descriptionZh: 言语中喉的位置相对偏低，声道延长，共鸣条件随之改变。L 表示喉，下方偏低符表示位置下移。
entries.descriptionEn: The larynx occupies a relatively low position during speech, lengthening the vocal tract and changing resonance. L denotes the larynx, and the lowering diacritic below indicates downward displacement.
entries.usageZh: 用 L̞ 标记降低的喉位，并以同一说话人的参照位置判断。
entries.usageEn: L̞ marks a lowered larynx, judged against the same speaker's reference position.
entries.contrastZh: 喉位降低可与不同音高、不同发声类型结合。低音高及松弛听感不能单独替代喉位观察。
entries.contrastEn: A lowered larynx can combine with different pitches and phonation types. Low pitch and a relaxed auditory quality alone cannot replace observation of larynx position.

entries.descriptionZh: 嘴唇持续呈较开放的圆唇形状，口唇横向收拢，垂直方向仍保留较大开口，可参照元音 œ 的唇形理解。
entries.descriptionEn: The lips sustain a relatively open rounded posture, narrowing horizontally while retaining a sizeable vertical opening. The lip shape of the vowel œ offers a reference.
entries.usageZh: V 后的上标 oe 表示开圆唇设置，可加程度数字或标出持续范围。
entries.usageEn: Superscript oe after V denotes an open-rounded setting. Degree numbers or a sustained scope can be added.
entries.contrastZh: 与闭圆唇 Vʷ 相比，唇口更开放。这里概括持续唇形，各音段仍按实际音值转写。
entries.contrastEn: The lip opening is larger than in close rounding Vʷ. The label summarizes sustained lip posture; individual segments retain their actual phonetic transcriptions.

entries.descriptionZh: 嘴唇在一段言语中持续向两侧展开，唇口横向变宽。
entries.descriptionEn: The lips remain spread toward the sides over a stretch of speech, widening the mouth horizontally.
entries.usageZh: 用 V͍ 概括展唇设置，必要时标出程度与作用范围。
entries.usageEn: V͍ summarizes a spread-lip setting. Mark degree and scope when needed.
entries.contrastZh: 展唇强调横向展开，颌位偏开 J̞ 强调下颌下降。两种动作可分别观察和记录。
entries.contrastEn: Lip spreading emphasizes horizontal widening, while open jaw J̞ emphasizes lowering of the mandible. The two movements can be observed and recorded separately.

entries.descriptionZh: 在一段言语中，下唇持续接近上齿，形成明显的唇齿部位设置或次级调音。
entries.descriptionEn: The lower lip remains close to the upper teeth during a stretch of speech, producing a prominent labiodental setting or secondary articulation.
entries.usageZh: V 后加唇齿化附加符，标记这类持续音质。
entries.usageEn: The labiodentalization diacritic after V marks this sustained voice quality.

entries.contrastEn: The label summarizes the stretch's labiodental setting. Individual labiodental consonants still use their corresponding IPA symbols, such as f and v.

entries.descriptionZh: 在一段言语中，舌尖的调音作用较突出，舌冠音更多采用舌尖参与的构形。
entries.descriptionEn: The tongue tip has a prominent articulatory role across a stretch of speech, with coronal sounds tending toward apical configurations.
entries.usageZh: V 下加舌尖音附加符，表示舌尖化的整体设置。
entries.usageEn: The apical diacritic below V denotes an overall apicalized setting.
entries.contrastZh: 舌尖化强调主动参与的舌部，齿化和龈化则强调所趋向的被动调音部位。
entries.contrastEn: Apicalization emphasizes the active part of the tongue; dentalization and alveolarization emphasize the passive place approached.

entries.descriptionZh: 在一段言语中，紧邻舌尖后方的舌叶较突出地参与调音，舌冠音更多采用舌叶构形。
entries.descriptionEn: The tongue blade, immediately behind the tip, plays a prominent role across a stretch of speech, with coronal sounds tending toward laminal configurations.
entries.usageZh: V 下加舌叶音附加符，表示舌叶化设置。
entries.usageEn: The laminal diacritic below V denotes a laminalized setting.
entries.contrastZh: 与舌尖化 V̺ 的区别在于主要参与的舌部。舌叶化本身不限定唯一的被动调音部位。
entries.contrastEn: It differs from apicalization V̺ in the tongue part primarily involved. Laminalization alone does not specify a unique passive place of articulation.

entries.descriptionZh: 言语中持续带有舌尖后卷相关的构形和音色。舌尖向后上方抬起，影响相邻音段及整段语音的共鸣。
entries.descriptionEn: Speech persistently exhibits a retroflex configuration and quality. The tongue tip curls upward and backward, affecting the resonance of neighbouring segments and the stretch as a whole.
entries.usageZh: 用 V˞ 标记卷舌设置，单个音段的卷舌或儿化性质按相应转写规则处理。
entries.usageEn: Use V˞ for a retroflex setting. Treat retroflexion or rhoticity of individual segments according to the relevant transcription conventions.
entries.contrastZh: 卷舌设置与各种 r 音的关系因语言和说话人而异，r 音色也可由不同舌形形成。
entries.contrastEn: The relationship between retroflex settings and different r sounds varies across languages and speakers; rhotic quality can arise from different tongue shapes.

entries.descriptionZh: 舌冠部的调音持续偏向齿龈嵴区域。该标签与齿化平行，突出齿龈部位的整体调音倾向。
entries.descriptionEn: Coronal articulation persistently approaches the alveolar ridge. Parallel to dentalization, the label emphasizes an overall articulatory tendency toward the alveolar region.
entries.usageZh: V 下加双横线表示龈化设置。
entries.usageEn: A double horizontal line below V denotes an alveolarized setting.
entries.contrastZh: 齿化 V̪ 趋向上齿，龈化 V͇ 趋向齿龈。具体音段的部位仍在音段转写中保留。
entries.contrastEn: Dentalization V̪ approaches the upper teeth; alveolarization V͇ approaches the alveolar ridge. Individual segments retain their places in segmental transcription.

entries.descriptionZh: 言语中持续带有腭–龈部位的构形，舌冠部在齿龈后方附近调音，同时舌面向硬腭方向抬起。
entries.descriptionEn: Speech sustains a palato-alveolar configuration: the tongue's coronal region articulates near the area behind the alveolar ridge while the tongue body rises toward the hard palate.
entries.usageZh: 保留 V 下的双横线与上标 j，共同标记腭–龈化设置。
entries.usageEn: Retain both the double horizontal line below V and superscript j to mark a palato-alveolarized setting.
entries.contrastZh: 与单独的龈化 V͇ 或腭化 Vʲ 比较时，应同时注意舌冠部和舌面的构形。
entries.contrastEn: When comparing with alveolarization V͇ or palatalization Vʲ alone, consider both coronal and tongue-body configurations.

entries.descriptionZh: 舌面持续向硬腭抬起，使一段言语广泛带有硬腭部位的次级调音。各音段原有的主要调音动作仍可保留。
entries.descriptionEn: The tongue body stays raised toward the hard palate, giving a stretch of speech widespread secondary palatal articulation. The primary articulations of individual segments may remain.
entries.usageZh: 用 Vʲ 标记腭化范围，程度数字可进一步区分腭化的强弱。
entries.usageEn: Vʲ marks the scope of palatalization; degree numbers can further distinguish its strength.
entries.contrastZh: 腭化设置可叠加于多个不同部位的音段，无须把这些音段全部改记成硬腭音。
entries.contrastEn: A palatalized setting can overlay segments at several places of articulation without requiring all of them to be transcribed as palatals.

entries.descriptionZh: 舌后部持续向软腭方向抬起或靠拢，使一段言语带有软腭区域的次级调音和共鸣变化。
entries.descriptionEn: The back of the tongue remains raised or approximated toward the soft palate, adding secondary articulation and resonance changes in the velar region across a stretch of speech.
entries.usageZh: V 后加上标 ˠ，标记软腭化设置。
entries.usageEn: Superscript ˠ after V marks a velarized setting.
entries.contrastZh: 与小舌化 Vʶ 区分趋近的部位。软腭化描述舌部构形，软腭抬降控制的鼻化另行记录。
entries.contrastEn: Distinguish it from uvularization Vʶ by the region approached. Velarization describes tongue configuration; nasalization controlled by velum raising or lowering is recorded separately.

entries.descriptionZh: 舌后部持续向小舌及其附近区域靠拢，使言语带有小舌区域的次级调音。
entries.descriptionEn: The back of the tongue remains approximated toward the uvula and surrounding area, adding secondary uvular articulation to speech.
entries.usageZh: V 后加上标小型大写 R，表示小舌化设置。
entries.usageEn: Superscript small-capital R after V denotes a uvularized setting.
entries.contrastZh: 小舌化的收窄位置通常较软腭化更靠后。持续设置与单独一个小舌辅音的音段转写分别处理。
entries.contrastEn: Uvular constriction is usually farther back than velar constriction. A sustained setting is treated separately from the segmental transcription of a single uvular consonant.

entries.descriptionZh: 一段言语带有咽部收窄相关的音质，舌根后缩及喉入口的收缩可共同参与，改变声道下部的共鸣条件。
entries.descriptionEn: A stretch of speech has a quality associated with pharyngeal narrowing. Tongue-root retraction and laryngeal-inlet constriction may jointly contribute, changing resonance in the lower vocal tract.
entries.usageZh: V 后加咽化附加符 ˤ，标记咽化设置。
entries.usageEn: The pharyngealization diacritic ˤ after V marks a pharyngealized setting.
entries.contrastZh: 咽部、舌根和喉部动作可相互联系。与喉–咽化 V̙ˤ 对照时，需留意其额外标出的舌根后缩与喉咽紧缩。
entries.contrastEn: Pharyngeal, tongue-root, and laryngeal movements can be related. In comparison with laryngopharyngealization V̙ˤ, note the latter's additional specification of tongue-root retraction and laryngopharyngeal constriction.

entries.descriptionZh: 舌根后缩与喉咽部收缩相结合，形成较明显的喉–咽化设置。符号同时保留舌根后缩和咽化两个附加成分。
entries.descriptionEn: Tongue-root retraction combines with laryngopharyngeal constriction to create a prominent laryngopharyngealized setting. Both tongue-root retraction and pharyngealization remain in the symbol.
entries.usageZh: V 下加舌根后缩符，再加咽化符 ˤ，构成 V̙ˤ。
entries.usageEn: Add the retracted-tongue-root diacritic below V and pharyngealization ˤ to form V̙ˤ.
entries.contrastZh: 与咽化 Vˤ 相比，本标签明确标出舌根后缩。组成符号的动作可彼此联动，转写时结合整体构形。
entries.contrastEn: Compared with pharyngealization Vˤ, this label explicitly marks tongue-root retraction. The component gestures may be coupled; consider the overall configuration when transcribing.

entries.descriptionZh: 涉及咽门柱及相邻咽腔的整体构形，可伴随喉位降低、咽腔纵向扩展，产生较空阔、近似打哈欠时的音色。
entries.descriptionEn: An overall configuration involving the faucial pillars and adjacent pharynx, potentially with a lowered larynx and longitudinal pharyngeal expansion, producing a hollow, yawn-like quality.
entries.usageZh: V 后的上标带横 H 标记咽门化，字形借两个柱及其连接来提示咽门部位。
entries.usageEn: Superscript H with a bar after V marks faucalization; the shape evokes two pillars and their connection to indicate the faucial region.
entries.contrastZh: 咽门柱局部的牵拉或靠拢与咽腔整体的扩展可同时出现。该设置也可与较高音调结合，需与咽化 Vˤ 和单独的降喉位 L̞ 区分。
entries.contrastEn: Local tension or approximation of the faucial pillars can coexist with overall pharyngeal expansion. This setting can also occur at relatively high pitch; distinguish it from pharyngealization Vˤ and lowered larynx L̞ alone.

entries.descriptionZh: 腭咽通道开放，使鼻腔参与共鸣，一段言语因而持续带有鼻化音色。
entries.descriptionEn: The velopharyngeal passage is open, allowing nasal resonance and a sustained nasalized quality across speech.
entries.usageZh: V 上加鼻化符表示鼻化声；单个音段的鼻化可直接标在相应 IPA 字母上。
entries.usageEn: A nasalization diacritic above V denotes nasalized voice. Nasalization of an individual segment can be marked directly on its IPA letter.
entries.contrastZh: 持续鼻化设置与某一个鼻辅音分别记录。鼻腔共鸣和可闻的鼻部气流噪声也属于不同观察内容。
entries.contrastEn: A sustained nasalized setting and an individual nasal consonant are recorded separately. Nasal resonance and audible nasal airflow noise are also distinct observations.

entries.descriptionZh: 鼻腔参与共鸣的程度减少，原本应带鼻音或鼻化性质的声音表现出鼻音成分减弱的音质。
entries.descriptionEn: Nasal resonance is reduced, weakening the nasal component of sounds expected to be nasal or nasalized.
entries.usageZh: V 上加去鼻化附加符，标记一段言语中的去鼻化设置。
entries.usageEn: The denasalization diacritic above V marks a denasalized setting across a stretch of speech.
entries.contrastZh: 需与该语言及说话人的参照状态比较。单个鼻音的部分去鼻化可使用 extIPA 对应附加符记录。
entries.contrastEn: Compare with the language's and speaker's reference setting. Partial denasalization of an individual nasal can use the corresponding extIPA diacritic.

entries.descriptionZh: 下颌持续处于较低、较开放的位置，口腔开度增大，元音可能整体趋向较开的音值。
entries.descriptionEn: The mandible remains relatively low and open, enlarging the oral aperture; vowels may tend toward more open qualities overall.
entries.usageZh: J 表示下颌，偏低附加符表示颌位偏开，组合为 J̞。
entries.usageEn: J denotes the jaw and the lowering diacritic denotes an open-jaw position, giving J̞.
entries.contrastZh: 下颌位置和舌高会相互影响，也可分别调整。各元音的实际音值仍须逐项转写。
entries.contrastEn: Jaw position and tongue height influence each other but can also be adjusted separately. Transcribe each vowel's actual quality individually.

entries.descriptionZh: 下颌持续处于较高、较闭的位置，口腔开度减小，元音可能整体趋向较闭的音值。
entries.descriptionEn: The mandible remains relatively high and closed, reducing the oral aperture; vowels may tend toward closer qualities overall.
entries.usageZh: J 加偏高附加符表示颌位偏闭，组合为 J̝。
entries.usageEn: J with the raising diacritic denotes a close-jaw position: J̝.
entries.contrastZh: 与颌位偏开 J̞ 相对。标签记录持续颌位，单个元音的舌高与实际开口度仍按观察转写。
entries.contrastEn: It contrasts with open jaw J̞. The label records a sustained jaw position; transcribe individual vowel height and actual aperture from observation.

entries.descriptionZh: 下颌在一段言语中持续偏向说话人自身的右侧，形成侧偏的口形和调音设置。
entries.descriptionEn: The mandible remains displaced toward the speaker's own right over a stretch of speech, producing a lateralized mouth posture and articulatory setting.
entries.usageZh: J 下加向右侧偏的附加符，表示颌位偏右。
entries.usageEn: A rightward-displacement diacritic below J denotes jaw displacement to the right.
entries.contrastZh: 左右以说话人为参照。面对说话人观察时，视觉上的左右与标签所指方向相反。
entries.contrastEn: Left and right are referenced to the speaker. When facing the speaker, visually observed left and right are reversed relative to the label.

entries.descriptionZh: 下颌在一段言语中持续偏向说话人自身的左侧，形成侧偏的口形和调音设置。
entries.descriptionEn: The mandible remains displaced toward the speaker's own left over a stretch of speech, producing a lateralized mouth posture and articulatory setting.
entries.usageZh: J 下加向左侧偏的附加符，表示颌位偏左。

entries.descriptionZh: 下颌相对上颌向前突出，下牙与下唇的位置随之改变，影响一段言语中的调音和共鸣。
entries.descriptionEn: The mandible protrudes relative to the maxilla, shifting the lower teeth and lip and affecting articulation and resonance across speech.
entries.usageZh: J 下加前移附加符，表示颌位突出。
entries.usageEn: The advancement diacritic below J denotes jaw protrusion.
entries.contrastZh: 标签描述说话时的颌位。牙齿咬合关系及舌头是否伸出口外需要分别观察，舌突出可使用 Θ。
entries.contrastEn: The label describes jaw posture during speech. Dental occlusion and whether the tongue extends outside the mouth require separate observation; Θ can mark tongue protrusion.

entries.descriptionZh: 舌头在一段言语中持续向口外突出，至少舌尖保持外伸，程度较强时舌叶也可明显露出。
entries.descriptionEn: The tongue remains protruded outside the mouth across a stretch of speech, with at least the tip extended; stronger protrusion may visibly expose the blade too.
entries.usageZh: 用大写 Θ 概括舌突出设置，程度数字可记录外伸程度的相对强弱。
entries.usageEn: Capital Θ summarizes a tongue-protrusion setting. Degree numbers may indicate relative extent.
entries.contrastZh: 小写 θ 转写齿擦音，Θ 表示持续音质设置。单个齿间音段与整段舌突出分别记录。
entries.contrastEn: Lowercase θ transcribes a dental fricative; Θ marks a sustained voice-quality setting. An individual interdental segment and tongue protrusion across a stretch are recorded separately.

entries.descriptionEn: Placed beside a voice-quality label, it indicates a relatively weak quality; for example, 1V! denotes weak harsh voice.
entries.usageZh: 点击输入数字 1，连续范围可写成 {1V! … 1V!}，两端保持相同标签。
entries.usageEn: Click to insert 1. A continuous stretch may be written {1V! … 1V!}, with matching labels at both ends.
entries.contrastZh: 1、2、3 依次表示较弱、中等、较强程度，判断时使用一致参照，不对应固定的声学数值。
entries.contrastEn: 1, 2, and 3 denote relatively weak, moderate, and strong degrees. Use a consistent reference; these do not correspond to fixed acoustic values.

entries.nameZh: 音质范围（原表完整例句）
entries.descriptionZh: 原表完整例句依次展示常态浊声、较强糙声，以及喉位偏高并伴较弱糙声。最后一段同时使用 L̝ 和 1V!，说明喉位与发声性质可以共同标记。
entries.descriptionEn: The original chart's full example successively shows modal voice, strong harsh voice, then a raised larynx with weak harsh voice. Its final stretch combines L̝ and 1V!, illustrating joint marking of larynx position and phonatory quality.
entries.usageZh: 按钮显示紧凑预览，点击输入包含方括号、重音和两段带标签范围的完整例句。
entries.usageEn: The button shows a compact preview. Clicking inserts the complete example with square brackets, stress, and two labelled stretches.
entries.contrastZh: 音质范围内可组合不同维度的标签，结束端按相反顺序闭合。程度数字只修饰其对应的音质。
entries.contrastEn: Labels from different dimensions can combine within a voice-quality span and close in reverse order at the end. Each degree number modifies only its corresponding quality.

entries.descriptionZh: 清龈-腭送气爆发音。上标 h 标记辅音释放后的送气。ȶ（U+0236）、ȡ（U+0221）、ȵ（U+0235）为非 IPA 官方扩展字母，常见于汉藏语及东亚方言学的龈-腭（舌面前）音描写；标准 IPA 可用 t̠ʲ/c̟、d̠ʲ/ɟ̟、n̠ʲ/ɲ̟ 或 tɕ/dʑ 替代。这是组合或扩展输入示例，不作为 IPA 官方新增基本字母计数。
entries.descriptionEn: Voiceless aspirated alveolo-palatal plosive. Superscript h marks aspiration after consonant release. The symbols ȶ (U+0236), ȡ (U+0221), and ȵ (U+0235) are non-official IPA extension letters common in Sino-Tibetan and East Asian dialectology for alveolo-palatal (anterodorsal) sounds; standard IPA uses t̠ʲ/c̟, d̠ʲ/ɟ̟, n̠ʲ/ɲ̟, or tɕ/dʑ instead. This is a combination or extended input example and does not count as an official added IPA basic letter.

entries.descriptionZh: 清龈-腭鼻音。上置清化圈 ̊（U+030A）标记无声带振动（依扩展表置于字母上方，常规转写亦见下置清化圈）。ȶ（U+0236）、ȡ（U+0221）、ȵ（U+0235）为非 IPA 官方扩展字母，常见于汉藏语及东亚方言学的龈-腭（舌面前）音描写；标准 IPA 可用 t̠ʲ/c̟、d̠ʲ/ɟ̟、n̠ʲ/ɲ̟ 或 tɕ/dʑ 替代。这是组合或扩展输入示例，不作为 IPA 官方新增基本字母计数。
entries.descriptionEn: Voiceless alveolo-palatal nasal. The voiceless ring above ̊ (U+030A) marks the absence of vocal-fold vibration (placed above here per the extended chart; subscript ring also occurs in general transcription). The symbols ȶ (U+0236), ȡ (U+0221), and ȵ (U+0235) are non-official IPA extension letters common in Sino-Tibetan and East Asian dialectology for alveolo-palatal (anterodorsal) sounds; standard IPA uses t̠ʲ/c̟, d̠ʲ/ɟ̟, n̠ʲ/ɲ̟, or tɕ/dʑ instead. This is a combination or extended input example and does not count as an official added IPA basic letter.

entries.descriptionEn: Voiceless labiodental affricate. entries.descriptionZh: 浊唇齿塞擦音。下桥 ̪（U+032A）置于双唇字母下，依扩展习惯标记唇齿构音（下唇与上齿），不表示舌与齿的齿部构音。阻塞除阻后直接过渡到擦音释放，依本表不带连音线记为连续组合；需要标示单一音段边界时可另加连音线 ͡。这是组合或扩展输入示例，不作为 IPA 官方新增基本字母计数。
entries.descriptionEn: Voiced labiodental affricate. The bridge below ̪ (U+032A) beneath a bilabial letter follows the extended convention for labiodental articulation (lower lip against upper teeth), rather than a lingual dental articulation. After stop release, articulation passes directly into fricated release; following this chart it is written sequentially without a tie bar, though a tie bar ͡ may be added when marking a single-segment boundary. This is a combination or extended input example and does not count as an official added IPA basic letter.
entries.usageZh: 点击输入整个序列。可在编辑框继续修改各基底或附加记号；码位按本条所列保存。
entries.usageEn: Click to insert the full sequence. Continue editing base letters or diacritics in the editor; code points are preserved as listed.

entries.contrastEn: Such entries supplement the consonant matrix and search input; verify actual phonemic status and phonetic realization against specific language data.

entries.descriptionZh: 清齿非咝塞擦音。下桥 ̪（U+032A）标记舌与牙齿的齿部构音。阻塞除阻后直接过渡到擦音释放，依本表不带连音线记为连续组合；需要标示单一音段边界时可另加连音线 ͡。这是组合或扩展输入示例，不作为 IPA 官方新增基本字母计数。
entries.descriptionEn: Voiceless dental non-sibilant affricate. The bridge below ̪ (U+032A) marks a dental articulation involving the tongue and teeth. After stop release, articulation passes directly into fricated release; following this chart it is written sequentially without a tie bar, though a tie bar ͡ may be added when marking a single-segment boundary. This is a combination or extended input example and does not count as an official added IPA basic letter.

entries.descriptionZh: 清龈-腭塞擦音。ȶ（U+0236）、ȡ（U+0221）、ȵ（U+0235）为非 IPA 官方扩展字母，常见于汉藏语及东亚方言学的龈-腭（舌面前）音描写；标准 IPA 可用 t̠ʲ/c̟、d̠ʲ/ɟ̟、n̠ʲ/ɲ̟ 或 tɕ/dʑ 替代。阻塞除阻后直接过渡到擦音释放，依本表不带连音线记为连续组合；需要标示单一音段边界时可另加连音线 ͡。这是组合或扩展输入示例，不作为 IPA 官方新增基本字母计数。
entries.descriptionEn: Voiceless alveolo-palatal affricate. The symbols ȶ (U+0236), ȡ (U+0221), and ȵ (U+0235) are non-official IPA extension letters common in Sino-Tibetan and East Asian dialectology for alveolo-palatal (anterodorsal) sounds; standard IPA uses t̠ʲ/c̟, d̠ʲ/ɟ̟, n̠ʲ/ɲ̟, or tɕ/dʑ instead. After stop release, articulation passes directly into fricated release; following this chart it is written sequentially without a tie bar, though a tie bar ͡ may be added when marking a single-segment boundary. This is a combination or extended input example and does not count as an official added IPA basic letter.

entries.descriptionZh: 龈-腭喷塞擦音。ȶ（U+0236）、ȡ（U+0221）、ȵ（U+0235）为非 IPA 官方扩展字母，常见于汉藏语及东亚方言学的龈-腭（舌面前）音描写；标准 IPA 可用 t̠ʲ/c̟、d̠ʲ/ɟ̟、n̠ʲ/ɲ̟ 或 tɕ/dʑ 替代。喷音记号 ʼ（U+02BC）标记喉部上升压缩口腔气体的外向喉气流机制。这是组合或扩展输入示例，不作为 IPA 官方新增基本字母计数。
entries.descriptionEn: Alveolo-palatal ejective affricate. The symbols ȶ (U+0236), ȡ (U+0221), and ȵ (U+0235) are non-official IPA extension letters common in Sino-Tibetan and East Asian dialectology for alveolo-palatal (anterodorsal) sounds; standard IPA uses t̠ʲ/c̟, d̠ʲ/ɟ̟, n̠ʲ/ɲ̟, or tɕ/dʑ instead. The ejective mark ʼ (U+02BC) indicates a glottalic egressive airstream compressed by laryngeal raising. This is a combination or extended input example and does not count as an official added IPA basic letter.

entries.descriptionZh: 上唇与下齿接触或接近的齿唇构音，区别于下唇与上齿形成的唇齿构音。附加号须与具体基底一起解释。
entries.descriptionEn: Dentolabial articulation uses upper-lip/lower-teeth contact or proximity, unlike labiodental articulation with the lower lip and upper teeth. Interpret the diacritic together with its specific base.

entries.contrastZh: 此记号描述观察到的语音特征，单凭符号不能推出病因或临床诊断。
entries.contrastEn: The marker describes an observed phonetic feature. The symbol alone does not identify a cause or clinical diagnosis.

entries.descriptionZh: 气流朝口外流出。吕佳、江荻（2013）所述2002版表5和表8列有此记号，当前2025简表未单列。
entries.descriptionEn: Air flows outward from the mouth. Tables 5 and 8 of the 2002 chart discussed by Lü Jia and Jiang Di (2013) include this marker; the current 2025 short chart does not list it separately.
entries.usageZh: 点击插入完整序列；有选区时替换选区。字符保存和复制均保持本条所列码位。
entries.usageEn: Click to insert the complete sequence; a selection is replaced when present. Saving and copying preserve the listed code points.
entries.contrastZh: 这是旧版扩展表的气流标记。不要与IPA的升阶符号ꜛ或整体上升箭头↗混用。
entries.contrastEn: This is an airstream marker from an older extended chart. Do not confuse it with IPA upstep ꜛ or global rise ↗.
